protocol.status: exploratory follow-up after mixed-target negative gains; same encoders, new targets; frozen predictions before these readouts

source_config.input_transform: swap the third and fourth latent coordinates; involution
exact_controls: uniform full joint distribution on F5^4
source_config.prospective_prediction: source one-hot character-kernel CKA under the involution is exactly 1 for P, 3/4 for M1/M4, and 1/2 for M2/M3; test whether learned hidden representations follow this ordering as fitting improves
source_config.status: exploratory prospective secondary experiment; registered before any model or transformation CKA from this protocol
source_config.scope: representation experiment with all source-domain inputs exposed; no new-entity generalization claim
source_config.world_basis_policy: all four physical source coefficients are nonzero for every source task in all three groups; all individual tasks are modular four-input sums up to per-coordinate category permutations

transfer_config.prediction: For a categorical subset lookup, lower algebraic target composition order should yield higher target accuracy at equal label budget. Neural linear and MLP heads are reported separately without assuming the same ordering.
transfer_config.target_policy: all eight common targets exclude every scalar-equivalent source direction; all source conditions share each world-target input split and nested balanced support
transfer_config.generalization_scope: target labels on input rows absent from target support, but every row was exposed in source pretraining; transductive new-task transfer
transfer_config.selection_policy: fixed 200-step learning-rate-0.01 heads, no target-test selection; preserve all targets, conditions and budgets
transfer_config.runtime_device: CPU readouts of the same frozen GPU-trained encoders
transfer_config.target_selection: new scalar directions; physical support >=3 in every basis; four minimum-order-2 and four minimum-order-3 targets; only mathematical selection

protocol.new_target_fixed_effect: mean of all eight original fitted target effects
protocol.new_basis_effect: mean of all three original fitted basis effects
limitations: Target restriction is motivated by observed earlier failure and is not an unconditional replication.
Physical support is three or four, rather than identical across all targets.
All source models and formula families are already known; only target identities are new.
Readout arithmetic is FP32 CPU; both trained and random conditions use the same backend.
Mathematical task definitions are privileged analytical inputs to prediction; not given to target neural learners.
